correctness.rationale: Outer mirror pairs produce iid increments e_X-e_Y; 2R_m minus the even central return indicator equals the proper border count. Multinomial enumeration gives p_q(k), first-return renewal gives the PGF, unique Fourier saddle with determinant q^{-q} gives p_q(k)~q^{q/2}(4pi k)^(-(q-1)/2). Factorial return moments prove half-normal and ternary exponential limits, transience/union bound proves the even-valued geometric law and rate, and monotone Tauberian theory yields the ternary survival constant. Independently computed word, state-DP and renewal distributions agree for all q=2,3,4 and lengths <=8, with published ternary zero-count agreement through length ten; finite checks are not substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The finite q-ary multiplicity PGF and exact constants resolve a motivated extension of binary border counting and the all-alphabet zero-border statistic. The phase transition from growing half-normal to logarithmic exponential to bounded geometric distribution directly quantifies typical border ambiguity of q-ary strings. The ternary borderline dimension is a substantive new natural invariant rather than a routine finite table.
